Chargers: public DC fast charging locations from the Alternative Fuels Data Center (U.S. Department of Energy), November 2026. Drive times: Mapbox Isochrone API, 10 minutes by car, measured outward from each charger. People: American Community Survey 2020–2024 block groups, placed at their 2020 population centers, so the share is an estimate.

Ten minutes from a fast charger

About 58% of Texans live within a 10-minute drive from a public DC fast charger, on 3.5% of the state's area. Click anywhere or search a place to see where 10 minutes gets you
